2. **[Canonical skeleton](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md#L12)** — [src/modules/entitlements/subscription-sync.module.ts:30](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/e27616f6cd7792b65596387d77d7859ed9d9d148/src/modules/entitlements/subscription-sync.module.ts#L30) — a second root-level `*.module.ts` inside an existing module, where the skeleton lists only `<kebab-name>.module.ts` at the root; no module under `src/modules/` has two today, and this module's own auxiliary Nest modules sit in the layer they wire (`routes/entitlements-routes.module.ts`, `domain/entitlements-repository.module.ts`). **Fix:** move the file to `src/modules/entitlements/routes/subscription-sync.module.ts`, beside the `routes/subscription-sync.service.ts` it provides, and update the import in `src/modules/billing/billing.module.ts` to `@/modules/entitlements/routes/subscription-sync.module`.

3. **[No speculative abstractions, unused exports, or dead code introduced (YAGNI)](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md#L48)** — [src/modules/entitlements/routes/guards/entitlement.guard.ts:18](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/e27616f6cd7792b65596387d77d7859ed9d9d148/src/modules/entitlements/routes/guards/entitlement.guard.ts#L18) — `EntitlementGuard` is an abstract base parameterised over `featureKey` for the one subclass that exists, and the staged-delivery sentence that would exempt it breaks off ("The next consumer is the over-limit act1827's refinement thread") without identifying the follow-up that adds the second subclass. **Fix:** state the follow-up in `## Summary` — e.g. "PLA-NNNN adds `<Feature>Guard` as the second `EntitlementGuard` subclass" — or collapse the base into `SafeSeatsGuard` and extract it when the second gate lands.
